title: 2025-26 Edition
requirements_text:
A. Complete the following:
FLM&MDA 85 | Introduction to Film and Visual Analysis
FLM&MDA 86 | Introduction to Television Analysis
FLM&MDA 87 | Introduction to New Media and Digital Technologies
B. Select three of the following:
FLM&MDA 101A | History of Film I: The Silent Era
FLM&MDA 101B | History of Film II: The Studio Era
FLM&MDA 101C | History of Film III: The Contemporary Era
FLM&MDA 101D | History of Radio and Television
FLM&MDA 101E | History of Digital Media
C. Complete either:
FLM&MDA 110 | Film and Media Theory
or
FLM&MDA 111 | Film and Media Theory and Practice
D. Select one of the following: 2
FLM&MDA 117A | Introduction to Screenwriting 1
FLM&MDA 117B | Intermediate Screenwriting 1
FLM&MDA 118A | Writing Television I 1
FLM&MDA 118B | Writing Television II 1
FLM&MDA 120A | Basic Production 1
FLM&MDA 120B | Intermediate Production 1
FLM&MDA 120C | Production Workshop 1
FLM&MDA 191 | Special Topics in Critical Practice
FLM&MDA 192 | Special Topics in Advanced Film Production 1
FLM&MDA 193 | Special Topics in Advanced Screenwriting 1
E. Select four of the following: 3
FLM&MDA 112 | Topics in Genre Study
FLM&MDA 113 | Topics in Narrative/Image
FLM&MDA 115 | Topics in Authorship
FLM&MDA 130 | Multicultural Topics in the Media
FLM&MDA 139W | Writing on Film and Media
FLM&MDA 143 | Critical Theory of Television
FLM&MDA 144 | Studies in New Media
FLM&MDA 145 | Topics in Popular Culture and Media
FLM&MDA 146 | Topics in Sound Studies
FLM&MDA 150 | Topics in Audiences and Reception
FLM&MDA 151 | Topics in Documentary and Experimental Film and Media
FLM&MDA 160 | National/Regional Cinemas and Media
FLM&MDA 161 | Global/Transnational Cinemas and Media
FLM&MDA 162 | Topics in US Cinema
FLM&MDA 185 | Topics in Television and New Media
FLM&MDA 190 | Special Topics in Film and Modern Media
FLM&MDA 194 | Special Topics in Interdisciplinary Studies
Requirements for the B.A. in Film and Media Studies
12 courses (48 units) are required for the major.
Departmental Requirements for the Major
Only three of the courses marked may be applied toward departmental requirements for the major.
Course may not fulfill requirement for category E.
Course may not fulfill requirement for category D.
Residence Requirement for the Major: At least five upper-division courses required for the major must be completed successfully at UCI.
